scope: Research/verification only. No Civic Map asset additions, removals or coordinate edits in this step.
methodology: Start from Makati City Government's named park inventories and operational/procurement records.
Use current local/map evidence only to verify present existence, point geometry and public-facing identity.
Do not equate historical and current park names unless the evidence supports the alias.
Separate current existence from exact coordinate readiness.

findings: Magallanes Interchange Park, Kennely Ann Lacia Binay Park, Guadalupe Viejo Cloverleaf Park and Makati Poblacion Park have sufficient current evidence to remain in the public-park completeness set.
Gil Puyat-SLEX should not yet be merged with Buendia Plaza even though the location/name evidence strongly suggests a relationship.
Post Office Pocket Park remains an official historical/current-candidate record but does not yet have enough current evidence for implementation.
The existing Civic Map Poblacion Park coordinate should be rechecked and likely corrected during implementation.
